dossier_meta.catalog_title: Determine the order of f_k(N; s, t) in general
dossier_meta.statement_text: Determine the order of $f_k(N; s, t)$ for all valid parameters $k \ge 3$, $s \ge k+1$, and $1 \le t \le \binom{s}{k}$.
dossier_meta.context_text: Despite substantial progress on the qualitative phase-transition structure of $f_k(N;s,t)$ as $t$ varies (the Erdős–Hajnal threshold conjectures, now resolved), the exact order of $f_k(N;s,t)$ has remained wide open. Theorem 1.6 determines the order $f_3(N;s,t) = \Theta(\log N/\log\log N)$ for a constant fraction of $t$-values in the range $(e(s), E(s)]$ for each fixed $s \ge 4$.
